# orq_audit_log_destination (Resource)

A signed webhook destination that receives the workspace's audit log events. Requires the audit logs feature on the workspace.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The signing secret is generated by orq and only exposed on create.
resource "orq_audit_log_destination" "siem" {
  display_name = "SIEM"
  description  = "Security event pipeline"
  url          = "https://siem.example.com/hooks/orq-audit"
}

output "audit_log_signing_secret" {
  value     = orq_audit_log_destination.siem.signing_secret
  sensitive = true
}

# Pause deliveries while the receiver is down; the backlog drains once it is `ACTIVE` again:
#
# resource "orq_audit_log_destination" "paused" {
#   display_name = "Archive"
#   url          = "https://archive.example.com/hooks/orq-audit"
#   status       = "PAUSED"
# }
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `display_name` (String) Destination name, unique within the workspace (1-255 characters).
- `url` (String) Absolute HTTPS endpoint that receives the signed events. Private and loopback addresses are rejected. The server only accepts a new URL while the destination is paused, so changing it on an `ACTIVE` destination pauses deliveries, swaps the URL, and resumes them.

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the receiving system (up to 1000 characters).
- `status` (String) `ACTIVE` (default) delivers events; `PAUSED` retains them and delivers the backlog once the destination is active again.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Creation time (RFC 3339).
- `id` (String) Destination ID assigned by orq.
- `secret_rotated_at` (String) Time the current signing secret was issued (RFC 3339).
- `signing_secret` (String, Sensitive) Secret for verifying delivery signatures. Generated by orq and returned only on create, so it is null on an imported destination and stale after a rotation made outside Terraform.
- `signing_secret_hint` (String) Last four characters of the current signing secret.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update time (RFC 3339).

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Audit log destinations are imported by their prefixed id. The signing secret is not recoverable on import.
terraform import orq_audit_log_destination.example auditdest_01kypdh9ga3f9m6gptyz6v9h7n
```
